observations.detail: TEST-02 Host management API applied a revoke for the distinct TEST-01 actor at 2026-11-22T07:32:18Z. Its actual native TEST-01 Workspace refresh then removed both Asset navigation and Asset count from the Wave 2 fixture module.

TEST-02 Host management API reapplied the same grant at 2026-11-22T07:35:25Z. On the next TEST-01 native Workspace refresh, Asset navigation and Asset count returned. The native Asset list then displayed nine Host-backed records, including the TEST-02 winning conflict value and the TEST-01 client-isolation record. Authenticated TEST-02 Host query independently returned HTTP 200, nine records and the expected package SHA-256.

limits: This case proves current navigation and list access after cross-device read revocation/restoration for one actor and package, not the complete role/scope matrix.
A corrected 17fa1b7 Client remains to be installed and retested.
